title: You don't have a discipleship problem... you have a disciple-making problem.
paragraphs: You don't have a discipleship problem... you have a disciple-making problem.

Churches are full.
Bible studies are everywhere.
Yet countless new believers quietly drift away because no one walks with them after they say "yes" to Jesus.
Jesus didn't say, "Make converts."
He said,
"Make disciples." (Matthew 28:19–20)
If you've ever wondered why so many Christians stay spiritually immature, this book will challenge your perspective and equip you with a biblical plan that anyone can follow.

📖 NEW RELEASE
How to Disciple New Believers Step by Step
This practical, Scripture-centered guide will help you confidently mentor new Christians—from their first days of faith to becoming mature disciples who can disciple others.
This isn't just another Christian book.
It's a roadmap for multiplying the Kingdom of God.
Inside You'll Discover:
✅ How to confidently disciple a new believer from Day One
✅ The first Bible lessons every new Christian needs
✅ How to build lasting spiritual habits
✅ Practical ways to teach prayer, Bible study, and obedience
✅ How to help believers overcome temptation and grow in holiness
✅ The biggest mistakes that cause new believers to stop growing
✅ A simple step-by-step discipleship framework you can immediately apply
✅ How to raise disciples who will make more disciples
🔥 MOST PEOPLE vs FEW PEOPLE
Most people celebrate decisions.
Few people stay long enough to build disciples.
Most people want a growing church.
Few people invest in growing people.
Most Christians know the Great Commission.
Few Christians actually live it.
The question is...
Which one will you become?
📚 Grow deeper in God's Word
🙏 Strengthen your prayer life
⚔️ Equip yourself for discipleship and evangelism
❤️ Build a Christ-centered lifestyle
• And more
⚡ JOIN THE MOVEMENT
Don't just consume Christian content.
Become someone who helps raise faithful disciples.
Let's build a generation that doesn't stop at believing—but learns to obey, grow, and make disciples for the glory of God.
